meta.description: 深灰黑背景、黑白运动模糊摄影，搭配荧光绿超大无衬线文字与优雅手写体叠加，辅以 HUD 式微小字与圆角细节，整体呈现赛博感强烈的情绪海报风格。
meta.recommended-uses: poster, social-post, album-cover, web-hero, ppt-cover, flyer

canvas-guidelines.margin: values are relative to full canvas; inside the margin, place a central near-black card that contains all content.
canvas-guidelines.texture: subtle but visible film grain / noise on both outer background and inner card, simulating printed matte paper.

color-palette.accent-colors: Bright neon green (#45d16a) is the only vivid accent color. Use it for all large display text, hand-drawn scribbles, micro UI labels and key graphic details. Photographs remain grayscale without extra colors.
color-palette.notes: Use flat solid colors only. Overall palette should feel dark and minimalistic: large areas of near-black card over dark grey background, with neon green drawing focus. Avoid additional hues; rely on value contrast and scale.

typography.primary-family: extra-bold condensed grotesk sans-serif for main titles (e.g., NO TIME)
typography.secondary-family: elegant high-contrast script / calligraphic serif for expressive words overlaid on the title
typography.title-style: Main title uses ultra-large, very condensed uppercase sans-serif, occupying most of the lower half of the card; letters are tall rectangular blocks with minimal letterspacing and can extend beyond the safe area horizontally.
typography.subtitle-style: Script subtitle is set in a flowing italic script with long swashes; placed diagonally or horizontally across the main title, often in the same neon green to create a layered typographic composition.
typography.body-style: Supporting copy and system info use very small sans-serif, often monospaced or technical-looking, in all caps or small caps; aligned to left or right in short 1–3 line paragraphs to keep the look dense and compact.
typography.alignment: centered hierarchy for main title; micro texts aligned left/right along grid edges; overall asymmetrical but balanced.
typography.special-text: Top meta bar (date, filename, series info) uses tiny monospaced uppercase in neon green, spaced along the top of the photo. Micro labels like “CTRL” / “DESGN” appear inside small rounded pills. Large tracking is avoided; typography relies on scale differences and overlaps.

shapes-and-effects.border-style: Most elements have no stroke; some micro-UI shapes (pills, small rectangles) may have thin neon green outlines or are filled; borders are always 1px equivalent, solid.
shapes-and-effects.shadow-style: none; depth is created by color contrast and layering, not by drop shadows.
shapes-and-effects.dividers: Use small circles, short horizontal lines, or pill-shaped separators to divide sections and evoke interface / HUD aesthetics; no full-width heavy rules.
shapes-and-effects.special-effects: Global film grain texture overlay; main photograph is high-motion blur grayscale. A vivid hand-drawn neon scribble is placed over a focal area (e.g., around a head), with varying stroke thickness and organic shape. Lower card edge of the photo may have a cut-out or curved shape integrating into the text area.

iconography.icon-style: minimal, interface-like glyphs (dots, small rounded rectangles, simple sliders) rather than illustrative icons.
iconography.corner-style: rounded for pills and HUD elements; square for larger panels.
iconography.usage: Icons appear as tiny decorative elements around buttons, between text blocks, or to suggest technical readouts; they should never overpower the typography or photo.

imagery.photo-usage: Central black-and-white photograph with strong motion blur or dynamic movement; framed in a large rounded rectangle occupying the upper half of the card. High contrast but no color.
imagery.illustration-usage: Hand-drawn neon scribbles or strokes overlay the photo or title; no figurative illustration beyond this.
imagery.mask-shapes: Photos are clipped to a large rounded rectangle or custom frame with a slightly curved bottom edge. Scribbles use freeform paths; no hard geometric masks.

pattern.description: Top-heavy dynamic layout：上半部分为黑白动态照片，下半部分为超大荧光绿标题与脚注信息，整体呈现代 UI / 赛博感排版。

pattern.purpose: 信息型页面 / PPT 内页
pattern.description: 保留顶部动感照片，下半部分改为多列信息与中号标题，仍使用荧光绿与 HUD 微元素。
竖版适配：顶部窄条为 meta 信息，中部为拉伸的动感照片，底部为大字与少量解释文字。

component.description: 在该风格中充当“CTA”或关键标签的元素，形似 HUD 控件的圆角胶囊。
component.shape: rounded pill (height small relative to width)
component.fill-color: either solid neon green with near-black text, or transparent/near-black with neon green 1px stroke and neon green text.
component.text-style: tiny uppercase sans-serif or monospaced, tight letterspacing, vertically centered; color应该与填充形成高对比。
component.icon-support: 一般不带图标；如需图标，可使用极简线性符号（如小箭头）放在文字右侧。

component.description: 顶部日期、系列编号、文件名等小标签。
component.shape: 无底色文本或放入极细高宽比的小矩形 / 胶囊中。
component.border-or-fill: 通常无边框，仅使用荧光绿文字；有时放入透明轮廓的细边框胶囊。
component.usage: 沿卡片顶部水平排布，左中右对齐，以分隔日期、标题、天数或主题等 meta 信息。

component.description: 中央深色面板，承载照片与所有文字元素，是该风格的基础容器。
component.layout: 占画布 80–90% 宽度和高度，居中；上半部分为照片，下半部分为文本与 HUD 元素；周围保持均匀留边。
component.shadow-or-border: 无投影；可选极细内描边提升边界感，但通常靠颜色差异区分。
component.spacing: 内部边距中等，保证照片和大字均不触碰卡片边缘。

component.description: 承载黑白动感照片的上半区容器。
component.shape: 大号水平长条的圆角矩形，下边缘可为轻微弧形或不规则切口，与下方文本自然衔接。
component.fill-color: near-black background behind the grayscale image.
component.text-style: 可在照片上缘叠加 very small neon green meta text。

component.description: 覆盖在人物或焦点上的荧光绿涂鸦笔触，用于强调情绪或注意力。
component.shape: 自由手绘开放路径；多重重叠、线条粗细略有变化。
component.border-or-fill: 纯描边，无填充，颜色为主荧光绿。
component.usage: 通常放在照片中央焦点上方（如人物头部），或穿插于大标题字母之间，不宜过多使用。

component.description: 极小字号说明文字或短句。
component.layout: 1–3 行紧凑文本，行宽较窄；可左右分布形成对称。
component.spacing: 与大标题保持足够间距，通常靠近标题或照片边缘。

component.description: 点、短线、小圆角矩形等界面式装饰元素。
component.shape: 小圆点、水平小条、极细圆角矩形。
component.border-or-fill: 实心荧光绿或细线描边。
component.usage: 放在照片和文字之间的过渡带、底部信息行之间，起到视觉节奏和科技感装饰的作用。

generation-guidelines.role: 你是一名 SVG 版式设计师，将根据本 XML 中的风格定义与用户给出的主题、尺寸和用途（如 ppt/海报/社交媒体），生成对应的 SVG 代码，呈现深色背景+黑白摄影+荧光绿排版的赛博情绪视觉。
generation-guidelines.usage: - 始终遵守 <visual-style> 中的颜色、字体和形状设定：暗灰背景、near-black 卡片、唯一的荧光绿强调色、黑白照片和强颗粒感。 - 根据用户指定尺寸比例，从 <layout-patterns> 中选择最接近的 <pattern>，并依据其中的 <region> 定位主照片、大标题、脚本文字和 meta 信息。 - 使用 <component-library> 中的 card、photo-frame、primary-button、tag、scribble-highlight、micro-label 与 hud-indicator 组合版面；保持上图下字的基本结构。 - 允许在不同比例下轻微调整区域高度（例如拉高照片或增大标题区），但要保持主照片位于上半区、大标题位于下半区的基本视觉节奏。 - 文字内容完全由用户主题决定；你只负责字体选择、字号层级和位置，使其符合本风格的强对比、技术感和情绪感。
generation-guidelines.flexibility: 可变部分：照片内容与构图、荧光绿涂鸦的形状和位置、HUD 小元件的数量和排列、micro 文案内容。应保持不变的部分：深色整体氛围、黑白照片+荧光绿文字配色、大号紧凑无衬线标题、上图下字的基本结构、顶部和底部的细小 meta 信息行以及整体无阴影的扁平视觉。
generation-guidelines.recommended-workflow: 1) 创建整体深灰画布并添加轻微噪点。2) 在中心放置 near-black card 组件。3) 在卡片上半区添加 photo-frame 与黑白照片，保证宽度接近卡片宽度。4) 在照片上方或内部放置 top-meta-bar 与必要的 tag。5) 在照片焦点处绘制荧光绿 scribble-highlight。6) 在下半区布置 big-title 与 script-overlay，并在其附近放置左右 micro-label 与 hud-indicator。7) 最底部添加 bottom-meta-row，检查对齐与留白，确保荧光绿元素在画面中均衡分布。

negative-guidelines.forbidden-colors: 避免使用多种鲜艳颜色或暖色系主色；除黑、灰、白与主荧光绿外，不要引入额外色相（照片也保持黑白）。
negative-guidelines.forbidden-effects: 禁止明显投影、发光描边、内发光、3D 挤出、渐变背景或玻璃拟态效果；不要使用柔和淡彩风格。
negative-guidelines.forbidden-layouts: 避免将大标题移动到顶部或与照片交换位置；不要使用密集多列文本或标准企业型网格；避免圆角过大的卡片或彩色图标破坏冷硬科技感。
negative-guidelines.notes: 不要在照片上叠加彩色滤镜；不要使用卡通插画或细线图标；不要让荧光绿文字与背景对比不足（例如放在浅色块上）。整体应保持深色、克制、高对比的海报质感。
